findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.providersignal.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_practice_triggers · Private data: lookup_provider_by_npi, search_providers, get_territory_summary, get_new_practice_registrations, get_practice_triggers, get_medicaid_rates, get_medicaid_fee_schedule, find_medicaid_dentists, score_providers · Public sink: get_territory_summary, get_medicaid_fee_schedule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_practice_triggers · Private data: lookup_provider_by_npi, search_providers, get_territory_summary, get_new_practice_registrations, get_practice_triggers, get_medicaid_rates, get_medicaid_fee_schedule, find_medicaid_dentists, score_providers · Public sink: get_territory_summary, get_medicaid_fee_schedule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
